_comment: As v4_s1_v4_ll.json, with all three robots in ONE team.

Teams are team_1.. in order of appearance and robots are <type>_<team ordinal> (user, 2026-09-13; unified across every S1 layout). The V4 set a team came from (M5, M3, ...) survives only in each robot's _v4_prim.
The split in the original is deliberate -- two teams give chain and
centralized inter-team traffic to carry. This variant removes that so the
handoff can be watched without it: one brain sees all three robots in one
prompt and allocates the whole Ridgeback -> Jackal -> Ridgeback chain in a
single call, rather than two brains negotiating it through messages.
Everything else -- models, positions, scales, base_locked_while_holding --
is copied unchanged, so this differs from the original in exactly one field.
